items.raw_excerpt: O Flamengo chega à disputa após ter vencido o clube equatoriano por 2 a 0 no jogo de ida, ocorrido na quinta-feira (10), na capital Quito.
items.summary_en: Rádio Nacional will broadcast the Libertadores game between Flamengo and Independiente del Valle. Flamengo reached this round after beating the Ecuadorian club 2-0 in the first leg in Quito on Thursday.

items.raw_excerpt: El capitán y goleador histórico de Universidad Católica envió un saludo a los seguidores "cruzados" en la previa de Fiestas Patrias y llamó a celebrar con responsabilidad.
items.summary_en: Zampedri, the captain and historic top scorer of Universidad Católica, sent a message to "cruzados" fans before Chile's Fiestas Patrias holiday. He urged them to celebrate responsibly.
items.summary_ko: 산티아고 Catholic 대학교(UC)의 주장이자 역대 최다 득점자인 삼페드리가 칠레 건국절(파이에스 파트리아스)을 앞두고 "크루사도스" 팬들에게 인사를 전했다. 그는 책임감 있게 축하해 줄 것을 당부했다.

items.raw_excerpt: The athlete who had a bout of faecal incontinence during a HYROX competition has issued a public apology and retroactively withdrawn from the race, handing back points earned in the event.
items.summary_en: Joanna Wietrzyk had a bout of faecal incontinence during a HYROX race. She kept running but later said sorry in public. She also left the race after the fact and gave back her points.
items.summary_ko: 조안나 비에트리크는 HYROX 경기 중 대변을 참지 못하는 일이 있었다. 그녀는 경기를 계속했지만 뒤늦게 공개 사과했다. 경기 결과를 번복하며 얻은 점수도 반납했다.
items.title_en: Athlete Joanna Wietrzyk apologises for continuing HYROX race after soiling herself
items.title_ko: 대변 실수 후에도 경기를 계속한 HYROX 선수 조안나 비에트리크, 공개 사과
items.title_original: Athlete Joanna Wietrzyk apologises for continuing HYROX race after soiling herself

items.raw_excerpt: The union representing Canadian workers at Stellantis is urging the automaker to keep its commitment to retooling its Brampton Ont., plant as the company looks poised to sell it instead.
items.summary_en: The union for Canadian workers at Stellantis wants the company to keep its promise to retool the Brampton, Ontario plant. The automaker now looks ready to sell the site instead. Workers worry about their jobs if the plant is closed or sold.
items.summary_ko: 스텔란티스 캐나다 노동자 노조는 회사가 온타리오주 브램프턴 공장 개조 약속을 지키라고 요구하고 있다. 완성차 업체가 대신 공장을 매각하려는 움직임을 보이고 있어서다. 공장이 닫히거나 팔리면 일자리가 사라질까 노동자들은 걱정하고 있다.
items.title_en: 'Don't close, don't sell': Union asks Stellantis to keep Brampton plant
items.title_ko: '닫지 말고 팔지 마세요' 노조, 스텔란티스에 브램프턴 공장 유지 촉구
items.title_original: 'Don't close, don't sell': Union implores Stellantis to keep Brampton plant as automaker signals sale

items.raw_excerpt: Expert highlights Puthoor zoo as a relocation model for Thiruvananthapuram zoo, addressing space constraints and animal welfare concerns.
items.summary_en: An expert says Puthoor zoo can be a model for relocating the Thiruvananthapuram zoo. The plan addresses space limits and animal welfare. The expert calls Puthoor a good example for the move.
items.summary_ko: 한 전문가가 푸투르 동물원을 티루바난타푸람 동물원 이전의 본보기로 제시했다. 이번 논의는 공간 부족과 동물 복지 문제를 다룬다. 이 전문가는 푸투르 동물원을 이전의 좋은 사례로 평가했다.
items.title_en: Puthoor Zoo a Model for Relocation, Expert Says

items.title_original: Puthoor zoo a model for relocation: expert

items.raw_excerpt: The American musician will perform on the festival's final day, alongside Tame Impala.
items.summary_en: An American singer named Sombr will play on the last day of a music festival in Portugal. The band Tame Impala will also perform on the same day.

items.raw_excerpt: El peruano, actual 35° del ranking ATP, afirmó que podría superar a Elena Rybakina incluso si estuviera ubicado entre los 100 o 200 mejores del circuito masculino y sus dichos generaron amplio debate en redes sociales.
items.summary_en: Peruvian tennis player Ignacio Buse, ranked 35th on the ATP tour, said he could beat Elena Rybakina even if he were ranked 100th or 200th in the men's tour. His words caused a wide debate on social media.
items.summary_ko: 페루의 테니스 선수 이그나시오 부세는 남자 투어에서 100위나 200위에 밀려도 엘레나 리바키나를 이길 수 있다고 말했습니다. 그의 발언은 사회관계망에서 큰 논란을 불러일으켰습니다.
items.title_en: Peruvian player says he could beat WTA top player

items.title_original: Peruano Ignacio Buse generó revuelo al afirmar que le ganaría a la número uno de la WTA

items.raw_excerpt: Livro idealizado pela Rede Katahirine - Ler o vento, filmar o mundo: pesquisa-mapeamento do cinema das mulheres indígenas no Brasil - será lançado nesta quinta-feira (17), em Brasília.
items.summary_en: A book about indigenous women filmmakers in Brazil will be launched in Brasilia on Thursday. It shows their challenges in getting film financing. The project was created by the Katahirine Network.
items.summary_ko: 카타히리네 네트워크가 기획한 책이 목요일 브라질리아에서 출간된다. 이 책은 브라질 원주민 여성 영화인들이 영화 자금을 조달할 때 겪는 어려움을 보여 준다.
items.title_en: Book maps indigenous women filmmakers in Brazil
items.title_ko: 원주민 여성 영화인 다룬 책, 브라질리아에서 출간

items.raw_excerpt: I wrote Soul Notes at the start of 2022 and it’s included on the Mnemonics albums; Part 1 for the solo piano and Part 2 as piano with orchestra too, the latter being recorded at Air Studios in London, and which was released the following year in 2023.
items.summary_en: The artist wrote Soul Notes in early 2022. It appears on the Mnemonics albums, with Part 1 as solo piano and Part 2 as piano with orchestra. Part 2 was recorded at Air Studios in London and released in 2023.
items.summary_ko: 이 음악은 2022년 초에 만들어졌다. 므네모닉 앨범에 수록되었고, 1부는 솔로 피아노, 2부는 피아노와 오케스트라로 연주된다. 2부는 런던 에어 스튜디오에서 녹음되어 2023년에 발매되었다.

items.raw_excerpt: A exposição "Padrão Reativo" reúne peças de cerâmica de Christina Machado, José Paulo e Mauricio Castro na Torre Malakoff, no Bairro do Recife, a partir desta quinta-feira (17), com abertura às 19h
items.summary_en: A show called Padrão Reativo features glazed ceramics by Christina Machado, José Paulo, and Mauricio Castro. It opens Thursday at 7pm at Torre Malakoff in Bairro do Recife.
items.summary_ko: '패드라웅 헤아티부' 전시에 크리스티나 마차두, 조제 파울루, 마우리시우 카스트로의 유약 도자기 작품이 전시된다. 이번 목요일 저녁 7시, 레시페 구 토레 말라코프에서 막을 올린다.

items.summary_en: Brazilian singer Leci Brandão has been nominated for a Latin Grammy award. She is a finalist for best samba and pagode album. At 82 years old, she has been making music for 50 years.

items.raw_excerpt: At peak times, 12 trains pass through the Glenview Road crossing every hour. Within six months, that will increase to 16 trains per hour.
items.summary_en: At busy times, 12 trains pass the Glenview Road crossing each hour. That will soon rise to 16 trains per hour. Making the crossings safer will take decades to finish.
items.summary_ko: 혼잡 시간대에 글렌뷰 로드 건널목을 시간당 12대의 기차가 지난다. 곧 시간당 16대까지 늘어난다. 이 건널목들의 안전을 높이는 작업은 수십 년이 걸릴 전망이다.
items.title_en: West Auckland rail crossing upgrades will take decades

items.title_original: Improving safety on West Auckland rail crossings will take decades

items.raw_excerpt: Lisbon has lost around 8,300 registered local accommodation (AL) properties since the pandemic, as house prices in the capital have continued to rise despite the reduction and tighter restrictions on short-term rentals.
items.summary_en: Lisbon has lost about 8,300 registered local accommodation properties since the pandemic. House prices in the capital keep rising even as short-term rentals face tighter rules.
items.summary_ko: 리스본은 팬데믹 이후 등록된 지역 숙박업소가 약 8,300곳 줄었다. 단기 임대 규제가 강해졌음에도 수도의 집값은 계속 오르고 있다.
items.title_en: Lisbon loses 8,300 local lodging homes as prices rise

items.raw_excerpt: Ambos duelos entre albos e itálicos se jugarán en Ñuñoa debido a conciertos en el Monumental y La Florida.
items.summary_en: Both Copa Chile matches between Colo Colo and Audax will be played at the Estadio Nacional in Ñuñoa. The venue changed because concerts are booked at the Monumental and La Florida stadiums.

items.title_original: La llave de Colo Colo y Audax por Copa Chile se jugará por completo en el Nacional

items.raw_excerpt: Pedro Parola Un enorme hoyo, derivado a una fuga de agua se mantiene sobre la carretera federal 190 a la altura de Pueblo Nuevo en la Ciudad de Oaxaca. De acuerdo con vecinos y automovilistas, esto…
items.summary_en: A huge hole caused by a water leak stays open on Federal Highway 190 in Pueblo Nuevo, Oaxaca City. Neighbors and drivers say the opening is still on the road. It is a small local problem on a busy highway.
items.summary_ko: 오악사카시 푸에블로누에보의 190번 국도에 물이 새어 생긴 큰 구멍이 아직 도로 위에 남아 있다. 주민과 운전자들은 그 구멍이 지금도 길 위에 있다고 말한다. 이는 붐비는 국도에서 벌어진 작은 지역 생활 문제다.
items.title_en: Huge Hole from Water Leak Stays Open on Highway 190 in Oaxaca

items.raw_excerpt: Why are we allowing AI to rewrite both history and our recollection of it? And, more importantly, what’s up with Argentina and the 80s?
items.summary_en: The author asks why AI is allowed to change history and memory. The piece also wonders what Argentina has to do with the 1980s. It is a culture essay about neon windbreakers and the 80s.
items.summary_ko: 저자는 AI가 역사와 우리 기억까지 바꾸어도 되는지 묻습니다. 그리고 1980년대의 아르헨티나가 대체 무슨 관련이 있는지도 이야기합니다. 네온 바람막이를 중심으로 한 문화 에세이다.
items.title_en: The existential B-side of 1980s neon windbreakers
items.title_original: The existential B-side of 1980s neon windbreakers

items.raw_excerpt: More than 2000 children changed schools twice or more last year - the lowest number of transient students the country has seen in more than a decade of records.
items.summary_en: More than 2000 children in New Zealand changed schools two or more times last year. That is the lowest number of transient students in over ten years of records. Fewer children are now moving between schools.
items.summary_ko: 지난해 뉴질랜드에서 두 번 이상 학교를 옮긴 아이가 2000명이 넘었습니다. 이는 10년 넘게 쌓은 기록 가운데 가장 적은 수치입니다. 학교를 자주 옮기는 학생이 점점 줄고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Student transience falls to lowest point in more than a decade
items.title_ko: 학생 전학, 10년 만에 최저 수준으로 떨어져
items.title_original: Student transience falls to lowest point in more than a decade
